title: Sajda ek aisa
body:
Sajda ek aisa
Sajda ek aisa karbobala me adaa hua..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske sabab hai khana e kaaba bacha hua
1. Is baat ke gawaah shah e mursaleen hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jis khaak ke khameer se yusuf haseen hai
us me husain ka hai paseena mila hua
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Heere pade the kaanch ke tukdo ke saath saath
zehra ne chun liye hai ye kehkar jawaherat
<<DIVIDER>>
in aasuo pe naam hai mera likha hua
3. Jaisa diya hai wesa hi fanoos chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
jannat ke shahzade ko malboos chahiye
rizwaan laao arsh se kurta sila hua
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Darwaza e ali ke namak khaar aagae
jannat me shahe deen ke azadar aagae
<<DIVIDER>>
sach hogaya husain ki maa ka kaha hua
5. Pushte nabi pe aaj imamat ka naaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
waed mujhe bata ke ye kaisi namaaz hai
kis waaste nabi ka hai sajda ruka hua
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Wo bhi hai ek sipahi husaini sipah ka
karta hu ehteram me yu zuljanah ka
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak e shifa me uska bhi khoo hai mila hua
7. Chaaya hua dimaagh pe uske ghubaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
usko bhi ab husain ka ghum na gawaar hai
tukdo pe jo husain ke palkar bada hua
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Is meer e khush nawa ke tarannum pa naaz hai
sacchaiyo ko iske takallum pe naaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kyu ke hai ye husain ke darr ka padha hua
author: Mir Hassan Mir
